STRATEGY: All kills quick in AFTERNOON only. That rules out day workers only, so the pool is 55000 from routine. Never put more than 2 deaths in the morning, because that would also rule out students.
Kinds I see: R=regional North, S=gazette (sector, 20%), G=podcasts (age), F=forum, O=foreign. 2 criminals per kind per day, plus 1 national. National kills are always safe.
L learns a place only after 3 traced victims there. If L learns 3 of my kinds, the pool is about 55000*.25^3 = 859, which is 1000 or less, so I'm CAUGHT. Learning 2 kinds leaves about 2750-3437, which is safe.
GOAL: find ONE reachable kind X while X's traced count stays at 2 or less. Then exclude X forever and kill national + all 8 from the other 4 kinds = 9/day. That gives 45 per 5 days, so x4.
TEST METHOD: on a test day, kill national + the 2 criminals of ONE kind only. If deaths_traced rises by 1 or more, that kind is reachable and becomes X (its count = the increase, at most 2). If the rise is 0, that kind is inconclusive; test another kind next day. A kind can be retested only if its 2 earlier test kills gave 0 traced.
If X's count is exactly 1, I may kill exactly 1 more X criminal ever. Use it to reach 40 in a 5-day window early (days 1-5: 3 + 4*9 = 39, +1 gives 40, so x4 on day 5).
LOG:
Day 1: TEST F (forum). Killed d1-1 (national), d1-6, d1-8 (forum). Traced before = 0. Tomorrow: compare deaths_traced. If 1 or more, X=F, so from day 2 kill national + R, S, G, O all, in the afternoon. If 0, test O (foreign) on day 2.

KEY FACTS: FORUM IS REACHABLE (the day 1 test took traced from 0 to 2). So exactly 2 of R, S, G, O are reachable and 2 are not. Forum has 2 traced victims.
